name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
summary: Income support for eligible landholding farmer families.
benefit: The official portal describes annual income support of ₹6,000 for eligible farmer families. Exclusions and land records require official checks.

all.label: You did not pay income tax last year

documents.item: Aadhaar card
documents.note: Required, and the name must match your land record.

documents.item: Land record (RTC / Pahani / 7-12 extract, as your state calls it)
documents.note: Shows the land is recorded in your name.

documents.item: Bank passbook or account details
documents.note: The instalment is paid into this account directly.

steps.title: Check that your land record carries your own name
steps.detail: The instalment follows the land record, not the person farming the land. If the land is still recorded in a parent’s or relative’s name, that has to be corrected first, and it is the slowest part of this process.
steps.where: Village revenue office, or your state’s land-records portal
steps.typicalWait: Same day to check; a correction takes longer

steps.title: Open a bank account in your own name
steps.detail: Payments are made directly to a bank account held by the applicant. A zero-balance account under Jan Dhan can be opened without a minimum deposit.
steps.where: Any bank branch, or a bank correspondent in your village

steps.title: Link your Aadhaar to that bank account
steps.detail: Payment fails silently when the account is not Aadhaar-seeded. Ask the branch to confirm seeding is active rather than assuming it.
steps.typicalWait: A few days to take effect

steps.title: Register as a new farmer
steps.detail: You can register yourself on the PM-KISAN portal or have an operator do it at a Common Service Centre. Take the originals of everything above.
steps.where: pmkisan.gov.in, or any Common Service Centre

steps.title: Wait for state verification, then check your status
steps.detail: Your state government verifies the land record before any instalment is released. The portal shows the reason if verification fails, and most failures are name or account mismatches that you can correct.

steps.title: Keep your own record of what you submitted
steps.detail: Scheme Sathi does not file anything for you and cannot see your application status. Note your reference number and the date here so you know when to follow up.

fees: No fee. Registration and verification are free at a Common Service Centre and on the portal.

ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
summary: LPG connection assistance for eligible women in poor households.
benefit: LPG connection assistance. Poor-household declaration and official verification are required.

all.label: The connection is issued to a woman in the household
No LPG connection in the household yet

documents.item: Aadhaar card of the woman applying
documents.note: The connection is issued in her name.

documents.item: Proof of address
documents.note: Aadhaar is accepted when it carries your current address.

documents.note: Subsidy on refills is paid into this account.

documents.note: Used to confirm no existing connection in the household.

steps.title: Choose your gas distributor
steps.detail: Pick whichever of Indane, Bharatgas or HP Gas has a distributor near you — you will return there for every refill, so distance matters more than the brand.
steps.where: Any LPG distributor, or the Ujjwala portal

steps.title: Complete the KYC form in the applying woman’s name

steps.title: Open a bank account in your own name
steps.detail: Payments are made directly to a bank account held by the applicant. A zero-balance account under Jan Dhan can be opened without a minimum deposit.
steps.where: Any bank branch, or a bank correspondent in your village

steps.title: Collect the connection and ask for a safety demonstration
steps.detail: A safety demonstration is part of the connection, not an extra. Ask for it even if it is not offered, and ask where the nearest refill booking number is written down.
steps.typicalWait: Commonly within a couple of weeks

steps.title: Keep your own record of what you submitted
steps.detail: Scheme Sathi does not file anything for you and cannot see your application status. Note your reference number and the date here so you know when to follow up.

fees: The connection itself carries no security deposit. You pay for the stove and the first refill unless a current offer covers them — ask the distributor what today’s terms are.

benefit: Skills and enterprise support for eligible traditional artisans.

all.label: You work in one of the recognised traditional trades

documents.item: Aadhaar card
documents.note: Registration is done with Aadhaar biometric authentication.

documents.item: Bank account details
documents.note: Toolkit support and any credit are paid into this account.

documents.item: Proof of your trade
documents.note: What counts varies by trade — ask at the Common Service Centre what they accept for yours.

documents.item: Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
documents.note: Needed for the authentication step.

steps.title: Check that your trade is one of the recognised ones
steps.detail: The scheme covers a fixed list of traditional trades — tailoring and garment work are on it, along with carpentry, pottery, metalwork and others. If your work is not listed, registration will not proceed.
steps.where: pmvishwakarma.gov.in, or ask at a Common Service Centre

steps.title: Confirm your mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar
steps.detail: Registration uses Aadhaar biometric authentication and will stop at this step if the linked number is old or unreachable. This is the most common reason a registration visit fails.
steps.typicalWait: A few days to take effect

steps.title: Open a bank account in your own name
steps.detail: Payments are made directly to a bank account held by the applicant. A zero-balance account under Jan Dhan can be opened without a minimum deposit.
steps.where: Any bank branch, or a bank correspondent in your village

steps.title: Register at a Common Service Centre
steps.detail: Registration cannot be completed at home — it needs the biometric step in person. Registration is followed by verification at the local body and district level.

steps.title: Complete the skill assessment before claiming toolkit support
steps.detail: Toolkit and credit support follow the training and assessment stage rather than registration. Ask when the next session near you is scheduled.
steps.where: The training centre you are assigned

steps.title: Keep your own record of what you submitted
steps.detail: Scheme Sathi does not file anything for you and cannot see your application status. Note your reference number and the date here so you know when to follow up.

fees: Registration is free. Credit support carries interest at the rate stated in the scheme terms.

benefit: Scholarships for eligible higher education students.

all.label: You are studying at a recognised institution
Family income within the scheme limit

documents.item: Class 12 marksheet
documents.note: Selection is based on your board result.

documents.note: Issued by your Tahsildar or equivalent revenue officer.

documents.item: Proof of admission and current enrolment
documents.note: From the institution you are attending now.

documents.note: Not a parent’s account — this is a common reason for rejection.

documents.item: Aadhaar card

steps.title: Get the family income certificate first
steps.detail: This takes longer than the application itself and expires, so start here. An out-of-date certificate is rejected.

steps.title: Open a bank account in the student’s own name
steps.detail: The scholarship cannot be paid into a parent’s or guardian’s account. If the student is already banking, confirm the account is Aadhaar-seeded.

steps.title: Register on the National Scholarship Portal
steps.detail: Applications open once a year and close on a fixed date. Missing the window means waiting a full year, so check the closing date before anything else.

steps.title: Have your institution verify the application
steps.detail: An application the institution has not verified is not considered, and this verification is not automatic. Confirm with the college office that they have done it.
steps.typicalWait: Depends on the institution — follow up

steps.title: Keep your own record of what you submitted
steps.detail: Scheme Sathi does not file anything for you and cannot see your application status. Note your reference number and the date here so you know when to follow up.

steps.detail: Devices are fitted at camps run by ALIMCO and partner organisations rather than issued over a counter, because the device has to be measured to the person.
steps.typicalWait: Camps are periodic — ask for the schedule

steps.title: Attend the camp for assessment and fitting
steps.detail: Bring the person who will use the device, not only their documents. Assessment and fitting happen together.

steps.title: Keep your own record of what you submitted
steps.detail: Scheme Sathi does not file anything for you and cannot see your application status. Note your reference number and the date here so you know when to follow up.

fees: Devices are free or subsidised depending on household income. Ask the assessment camp what applies in your case.
